newsitem.title: USA: TIN STOCKPILE BIDS RANGE BETWEEN $2.4950-$2.5475.
newsitem.headline: TIN STOCKPILE BIDS RANGE BETWEEN $2.4950-$2.5475.

text.p: Bids for Wednesday's tin offering by the U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center range between $2.4950 and $2.5475 a lb, the agency said Wednesday.
The low bidder was Cambridge Street Metal, while the high bidder was Rotometals Inc.
Other bidders included Allied Deald, RMT Metals, F&S International, Ney Smelting, APOA, Baron Metals and American Iron & Steel.
The London Metal Exchange closing cash price was $2.52 a lb Wednesday.
The winning bids are expected to be announced Thursday.
